scope: 单公司官方财务资料的时点资格探针，不做选股效果、不代表全市场
source: SEC companyfacts/submissions JSON templates from official API documentation
purpose: 核财报期、filed/accn及提交acceptance时点、同报告期多版是否可区分；能否支持未来构造当时已知输入
selection_reason: 常见公开申报企业用于资料接口例子；事先指定，不按收益或因子值挑选
cutoff_example: 2024-06-28T23:59:59 America/New_York, only source-availability example not simulated trade
failure_policy: 保留响应失败，不改来源权限或抓付费资料；替代仅在剩余请求内有明确理由

additional_original_filing.reason: 由已保存submissions accession/primaryDocument定位；核FY2023原始字段，不扩大股票样本

actual_cutoff_policy.policy: filingDate strictly before decision day and acceptanceDateTime before 00:00 UTC on decision day
actual_cutoff_policy.reason: Conservative exclusion of same-day release ambiguity. Original plan retained above; this is a disclosed implementation refinement.
actual_cutoff_policy.effect: Independent check: none of the three selected annual filings/values changes because each filing preceded its decision day by multiple days or months.
actual_cutoff_policy.not_verified: intraday release completeness or first public dissemination clock
